shape/audit.go.patch:
diff --git a/shape/audit.go b/shape/audit.go
index 7fce6ec..5e33c7b 100644
--- a/shape/audit.go
+++ b/shape/audit.go
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@ import (
 	"fmt"
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
 	"slices"
 	"strings"
 
@@ -144,9 +145,23 @@ func auditPayload(args map[string]any) (map[string]any, auditReport, string) {
 	return rest, rep, ""
 }
 
-// auditInventedFix is the remedy a refused invented literal is given.
+var (
+	auditPathExt  = regexp.MustCompile(`\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$`)
+	auditCodeName = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.]+$`)
+)
+
+// auditInventedFix is the remedy a refused invented literal is given, chosen by the kind of the
+// literal: a file path, the name of new code, or any other literal.
 func auditInventedFix(literal string) string {
-	return fmt.Sprintf("- fix for invented literal \"%s\": find it at run time (for example find the form or link by its visible text), assert only what the request states, or move it to a Decision and stop asserting it", auditOneLine(literal))
+	lit := auditOneLine(literal)
+	remedy := "find it at run time (for example find the form or link by its visible text), assert only what the request states, or move it to a Decision and stop asserting it"
+	switch {
+	case !strings.Contains(lit, " ") && strings.Contains(lit, "/") && auditPathExt.MatchString(lit):
+		remedy = "list the directory at run time, drive the file found there, and do not assert the file name"
+	case strings.HasPrefix(lit, "alias ") || auditCodeName.MatchString(lit):
+		remedy = "record the name in a Decision of intent.md as the Shaper choice for the new code, so the approval card lists it, and assert only the behaviour"
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- fix for invented literal \"%s\": %s", lit, remedy)
 }
 
 func auditOneLine(s string) string { return normalizeWhitespace(s) }

wrong.step: Then shape-invented-fix-names-kind-remedy: the fix line for "test/acceptance/external-stall-outcome.test.cjs" contains "list the directory at run time"
